project_type: React 19 + Next 16 static-export storefront with a Python (amplify/functions) AWS Lambda backend; AWS Amplify Gen2 app d22dm4b0jn71jw
build_system: npm for frontend (next build static export + generator scripts); amplify ampx for backend; .venv for python
test_framework: pytest for Python (conftest.py at root, 5607 tests), vitest+jsdom for TS/React (643 tests across 44 files)
build_command: npm run build  (runs generate-public-pages.js && next build && generate-sitemap.js && generate-blog-search-index.js && generate-llms-txt.js)
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q   AND   npx vitest run   AND   npx tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: On HEAD f7304eba all four gates are green: pytest 5607 passed/1 skipped, vitest 643 passed, tsc clean, npm run build exit 0. Re-run all four after any change. New Python code must add pytest cases; new TS must add vitest cases. Do NOT deploy; AWS is unavailable.
snapshot_or_generated_files: npm run build emits out/ (static export), out/sitemap.xml, out/blog/search-index.json, llms.txt/llms-full.txt via generator scripts. public-pages.json generated by scripts/generate-public-pages.js. These are build outputs, not committed source except config/public-pages.json.
setup_instructions: node_modules already present (Node 22). Python venv at .venv (python3.12) already has deps. No npm install or pip install needed for tests.
environment_constraints: NO AWS credentials (aws sts fails) - every AWS/Cognito/S3/DynamoDB/Secrets/Lambda-deploy/live-provider item is BLOCKED-ON-ENVIRONMENT. GitHub via connections gateway: only wecare-digital/wecare-digital reachable; wecare-digital/material fork returns 404 (Material ESM adoption BLOCKED); GraphQL/gh-pr-checks unsupported. upstream material-esm/material and npm registry reachable. Never load/print secret values; never call get-secret-value; never perform payment capture/refund/mutation; never send WhatsApp. git-workflow: single branch stack, explicit-path staging only, no git add -A, no force push, no history rewrite. Do NOT push or open PR (orchestrator does that).
contribution_requirements: Steering: 00-current-owner-overrides (WAF/Security Hub out of scope; never trust dated AWS counts; never reset to historical SHA), 01-standing-authorization (proceed unattended for local/code/test/IaC; AWS deploy A3 but BLOCKED here), secret-handling + plaintext-source-policy (secrets by reference only, never in argv/log/report; rotation owner-only), aws-agent-rules (UpdateUserPool is full-replace; use scripts/cognito_pool_safe_update.py). All amounts integer INR paise, exact Decimal, no floats.
key_patterns: Payment webhook: amount/currency/status always re-verified against Razorpay API via lambda_utils.integrations.razorpay_verify, NEVER trusted from the event body (signing secret is in public git history). Dedup is lease-based (claim_event_with_lease + complete_event). money.py: Money(paise:int) + positive_paise reject floats/fractional/overflow. order_keys.py: WD-ORD- + 8 CSPRNG, legacy 12-char still resolves, PAYREF# reservation before external call, conditional-write order markers. checkout/handler.py: session-authority (customer_auth.require_customer), readiness gate, initiation DISABLED by default (CHECKOUT_INITIATION_ENABLED). customerAuth.ts: sessionStorage access token, clears last 30s, NO refresh token.
directory_structure: amplify/functions/{payments,ecommerce,messaging,core,ai,operations,shared}/ Python lambdas; amplify/functions/shared/lambda_utils/ecommerce/ shared commerce code; src/pages/ Next pages (cart.tsx, checkout/, account/, shop/, workspace/ staff); src/lib/ frontend libs; src/components/; tests/ pytest; src/test/ vitest; .kiro/steering/ rules; .kiro/specs/whatsapp-wix-commerce/ spec; config/ runtime config.
